source.author: verg
source.text: Huc undique Troia gaza incensis erepta adytis, mensaeque deorum, crateresque auro solidi, captivaque vestis congeritur; pueri et pavidae longo ordine matres stant circum.
source.text_original: Huc undique Troia gaza / incensis erepta adytis, mensaeque deorum, / crateresque auro solidi, captivaque vestis / congeritur; pueri et pavidae longo ordine matres / stant circum.
source.text_english: Here from every side is piled Trojan treasure, rescued from the burning shrines, and the tables of the gods, and bowls solid with gold, and captive robes; boys and terrified mothers stand around in a long line.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_original: crateres mensaeque volant araeque deorum / poculaque, insignis veterum labor.
reuse.text_english: craters and tables and altars of the gods fly about, and cups, a notable workmanship of the ancients.
